meaning: Workflow and planned downloader acceptance. A001-A043 passed through UPD-0302; A044-A060 not_run. Helper checks and defect characterizations do not prove future downloader correctness.
default_engines: Supported PowerShell 7.x on Windows; exact version recorded at execution

cases.given: Existing checkout and the handoff outside it.
cases.when: Inventory root, origin, branch, tracked/untracked changes and remote state.
cases.expected: Correct repository proven; unrelated changes preserved; baseline drift recorded; no automatic reset or stash.

cases.given: Clean feature branch.
cases.when: Preview overlay application, then apply explicitly and run again.
cases.expected: Only new handoff files copied; unchanged files recognized; conflicting files cause no overwrite; repeat application is idempotent.

cases.given: Task ready for handoff.
cases.when: Commit named files and push the feature branch.
cases.expected: Remote branch SHA equals local HEAD; draft PR created/reused or an authentication/permission blocker is reported honestly.

cases.given: Core test seam/module and the existing entry point.
cases.when: Import the core without invoking the entry point.
cases.expected: No prompts, network calls, directories, downloads or preference mutations occur.

cases.given: Declared Pester/PSScriptAnalyzer development versions.
cases.when: Run focused tests locally and equivalent GitHub checks.
cases.expected: Versions and engine are recorded; missing test tools produce a clear failure, not an empty green result; no runtime dependency added.

cases.given: Feeds with zero, one and several downloadable entries.
cases.expected: Selections are arrays; valid counts and progress; empty input is handled explicitly; no null/divide-by-zero errors on either Windows engine.

cases.given: Patched Windows PowerShell 5.1.
cases.when: Fetch a fixture page/feed through each request code path.
cases.expected: No legacy DOM parsing or security confirmation prompt; existing system security policy is not changed.

cases.given: Titles: dot, dot-dot, reserved devices, control characters, trailing dots/spaces, Unicode and long names.
cases.expected: Valid deterministic components; identifiers retained after shortening; Windows limits handled clearly.

cases.given: Output root plus malicious metadata and an existing junction under it.
cases.when: Plan and attempt writes into these destinations.
cases.expected: No escape from output root, no metadata-controlled drive/UNC path and no silent traversal through unsafe reparse points.

cases.given: Two valid titles which sanitize to the same component, with/without dates.
cases.when: Generate destinations for distinct episode identities.
cases.expected: No accidental skip or overwrite; case-insensitive collisions also handled.

cases.given: A response disconnects after an initial body segment.
cases.expected: Only an owned partial file exists after interruption; final name absent until completion; rerun never counts partial as complete.

cases.given: Empty response, HTML disguised as audio, wrong HTTP body length, or valid lengthless stream.
cases.expected: Invalid bodies fail; valid EOF-terminated audio can succeed; RSS enclosure length mismatch is advisory, not by itself proof of corruption.

cases.given: Completed media already exists or a second writer creates the destination before finalize.
cases.expected: No existing file is overwritten; temporary file is on destination volume; all streams close on failure.

cases.given: Stable RSS GUID / Atom ID; changed title, signed media query, feed title or explicit feed alias.
cases.expected: Identity remains stable where evidence permits; exact media request URLs are not destructively normalized; distinct feeds cannot collide by title.

cases.given: History JSON plus a simulated crash during its update or between finalize and history write.
cases.expected: Previous valid state retained; reconciliation is conservative; corrupted history is preserved and reported, not silently reset.

cases.given: A history-completed file has been deleted or its size changed.
cases.expected: History is checked against disk; missing/changed media is not blindly skipped; no unknown file is deleted.

cases.given: Copy of a legacy archive containing complete, partial, empty and ambiguous same-title files.
cases.when: Preview migration and then apply only explicitly approved adoption.
cases.expected: Existing file hashes remain unchanged; verified/adopted/unverified/conflict states are distinguishable; no blanket redownload or deletion.

cases.given: Legacy file has plausible audio and matching size but no trusted publisher digest.
cases.expected: No claim of cryptographically verified completeness; adoption requires an explicit policy/owner choice; remote content changes do not trigger overwrites.

cases.given: Feed discovery fails before a podcast title is known.
cases.when: Start a normal run and trigger failure.
cases.expected: A startup diagnostic exists in a writable fallback location or stderr reports why logging is unavailable; original failure is preserved.

cases.given: Dummy secrets in URL userinfo, queries, path segments, redirects, exceptions and Authorization headers.
cases.when: Write console, verbose, logs and a diagnostic export.
cases.expected: Shareable output contains no raw secret-bearing URL/header; use host plus opaque ID by default; runtime state containing secrets is excluded from exports.

cases.given: Unicode metadata, simultaneous startup and unwritable log destination.
cases.expected: Consistent UTF-8, unique run IDs; log failure never replaces the primary error; best-effort console fallback is clear.

cases.given: Fresh output path, normal feed and no existing log/config/history.
cases.expected: Feed-only reads allowed as documented; no media request, folder/file/history/config/log/lock creation or keep-awake mutation; no subsequent false completion.

cases.given: HTTP, HTTPS, file, ftp, javascript and invalid discovered/enclosure URLs.
cases.when: Validate initial input and each redirect/discovery target.
cases.expected: Only policy-approved HTTP(S) requests; TLS verification preserved; cross-origin credentials not forwarded; private local tests remain possible.

cases.given: External-entity DTD, internal DTD, oversized XML, invalid XML, valid RSS and Atom.
cases.expected: DTD rejected before expansion; no entity HTTP/file access; bounded response and parser resources; valid feeds parse.

cases.given: Transient failure, permanent 403/404, 429 or 503, Retry-After and network timeout.
cases.when: Run retry policy with test-injected delay/clock.
cases.expected: Attempts bounded; transient retries differ from permanent failures; Retry-After does not cause an early retry; wait beyond configured budget becomes deferred/failed.

cases.given: Headers stall, body stalls, or a large body continues making progress slowly.
cases.expected: Connection/header and idle-body limits work; active long downloads are not killed by an inappropriate short overall timeout.

cases.given: Owned partial plus matching strong validator.
cases.when: Request remaining bytes and receive consistent 206.
cases.expected: Result equals original media byte-for-byte; offset, total and validator checked; state belongs to this transfer.

cases.given: Server ignores Range, changes entity, uses only weak validator, omits validator or returns inconsistent range.
cases.expected: Never blindly append; safely restart with explicit logging or leave partial for review.

cases.given: 416, corrupted resume sidecar, or local partial belongs to another episode.
cases.expected: No false completion, cross-episode concatenation or unsafe deletion; validated recovery/fresh transfer only.

cases.given: Same direct feed or HTML show-page URL.
cases.expected: Shared resolution rules produce same candidates; already fetched feed response reused.

cases.given: Redirected show page with relative links, a base element, whitespace, HTML entities and multiple feeds.
cases.expected: Correct final base URI; all candidates deduplicated; interactive choice or clear deterministic/noninteractive policy.

cases.given: Valid empty feed, malformed feed and an HTML document containing the text <rss.
cases.expected: Root-aware classification and useful distinct diagnostics; substring matches alone do not prove a feed.

cases.given: RFC-style dates, ISO timestamps, time-zone offsets, missing/bad dates; cultures en-US, de-DE and fi-FI.
cases.expected: Culture-independent chronological ordering; deterministic ties/missing dates; documented filename-date convention.

cases.given: Old Atom entry edited after a new one is published.
cases.expected: Use published when available; updated only a fallback; Atom ID collected.

cases.given: Multiple audio/video enclosures; extensionless media; MP3/M4A/Ogg metadata.
cases.when: Choose enclosure and name final file.
cases.expected: Deterministic supported-audio choice; correct extension; no transcode; unsupported/ambiguous content explained.

cases.given: Generic octet-stream header with valid media, or HTML with audio/mpeg header.
cases.expected: Header alone neither guarantees validity nor rejects all generic audio; bounded sniffing, no promise of full decode/integrity validation.

cases.given: Two feed pages with a duplicate entry, next-page cycle and configured page ceiling.
cases.expected: Deduplicated accessible entries only; cycle/budget stop visible; no silent claim of complete historical catalogue.

cases.given: Latest/Custom mode on a paged feed, and an unavailable later page.
cases.expected: Documented bounded selection; page-order assumptions explicit; retrieval gap yields incomplete result rather than false success.

cases.given: CustomCount alone, invalid count, conflicting mode/count and missing parameters in noninteractive mode.
cases.expected: Infer Custom when count alone; reject conflicting explicit mode/count; fail without Read-Host when noninteractive.

cases.given: All success, verified skips, episode failures, startup error and cancellation.
cases.expected: Documented 0/2/1/130 outcomes where cancellation is catchable; launcher preserves code; no [OK] after partial failure; module does not exit host.

cases.given: Double-click and command invocation from path with spaces and Unicode.
cases.expected: Simple interactive flow retained; arguments not evaluated as code; quiet/noninteractive path does not pause; missing script error visible.

cases.given: Two processes target same show plus another independent show.
cases.expected: Exclusive writer protection for same archive; safe lock release/recovery; no crash-corrupt manifest; independent destination policy documented.

cases.given: Insufficient disk or write permission and cancellation mid-stream.
cases.expected: Useful early errors; no existing files changed; handles closed; partial state preserved safely; no unknown PID killed.

cases.given: Known and unknown content length; interactive and redirected output.
cases.expected: Progress never reports misleading 100% before success; episode/byte information honest; readable noninteractive summary.

cases.given: Keep-awake explicitly enabled then success, failure and Ctrl+C.
cases.expected: Off by default; temporary and restored in finally; no machine-wide power setting change; limitations on hard kill documented.

cases.given: Named shows, malformed/unknown-version configuration and missing credentials.
cases.expected: Versioned validated config with safe permissions; clear failure on malformed input; no execution of strings; no plaintext secrets exported.

cases.given: Several shows including one failed feed.
cases.expected: Sequential bounded downloads, failure isolation, combined honest counts/exit; WhatIf does not mutate any show.

cases.given: All completed feature tasks.
cases.when: Run final structural/compatibility review and both engine suites.
cases.expected: No new runtime packages, syntax incompatible with 5.1, destructive defaults, duplicated untested engines or global state leaks.

cases.given: Published README, Get-Help and launcher instructions.
cases.when: Copy/paste each advertised example on Windows.
cases.expected: Commands work, functions/parameters exist, capabilities match tests, no promised unreleased feature or machine-wide security bypass.

cases.given: Empty feed and limited historical catalogue.
cases.expected: All scope is explicit; legacy unverified files not presented as verified; repair procedure avoids deleting originals.

cases.given: Clean committed source and a release version.
cases.when: Build ZIP twice with declared tooling.
cases.expected: Deterministic file inventory and version; checksums validate; includes imported modules/license/help; excludes logs, media, secrets, test fixtures and handoff history.

cases.given: Release ZIP extracted into a new directory outside checkout.
cases.expected: No hidden checkout dependency; source version traceable; original MIT license retained.

cases.given: Workflow definitions and release candidate.
cases.expected: Minimal job permissions, reviewed SHA-pinned actions, no pull_request_target execution of untrusted code, secret-safe artifacts; no automatic public release.

cases.given: Owner has not authorized publication, signing expenditure or settings changes.
cases.expected: Draft/artifacts ready; no tag push, release publication, merge, branch deletion, visibility/settings change or purchase occurs.

cases.given: Draft website content and real screenshot captured locally.
cases.expected: Current-version placeholder not falsely advertised as released; features/limitations/privacy/license/support accurate; real UI not generated imagery.

cases.given: No approved website domain/repository or deployment authority.
cases.expected: Portable static content/metadata only; no domain, hosting, DNS or live site changes.

cases.given: Fresh clone on active Windows machine and copied legacy test archive.
cases.when: Run end-to-end acceptance under both engines and release ZIP.
cases.expected: All mandatory cases have concrete evidence; user archive untouched; unrun/manual cases remain clearly outstanding.

cases.given: Mandatory cases pending, skipped, failed, or docs-only checks green.
cases.expected: Gate fails; bundle/server validation never substitutes for downloader acceptance.

cases.given: All mandatory gates met but publication approval absent.
cases.expected: Report ready-for-owner-review, remaining approvals and exact branch/PR/artifact/version identifiers; leave draft private/unpublished as applicable.

cases.given: Owner expressly authorizes a specific merge/tag/release action.
cases.when: Perform only that authorized action and verify remote outcome.
cases.expected: No inferred authority for other destructive/publication operations; audit trail records scope and resulting identifiers.
